_note: Stable error codes (snake_case). Services return these, never sentences. Spanish text: apps/web/src/i18n/es-ES.json errors.<code>.

auth_forbidden_role.meaning: Role does not allow the action (refusal recorded)

revision_conflict.meaning: Stale If-Match; body returns current version

policy_out_of_range.meaning: Service level outside 0–100 or max below min

import_type_not_allowed.meaning: Extension/signature mismatch, macros, or unsupported type

import_mixed_origin.meaning: Synthetic and real data in one dataset

import_duplicate_file.meaning: Same checksum already uploaded; explicit decision needed

margin_below_minimum.meaning: Margin after the update would be below 15%; release blocked unless an admin overrides

margin_pvp_unavailable.meaning: Selling price missing or stale; margin check unavailable

cost_no_entries_in_stock.meaning: No lot entry with remaining stock; no update request is created

override_admin_required.meaning: Only an admin may replace the median

policy_override_requires_approval.meaning: Override saved as pending; the recommendation stays in force

policy_override_self_approval.meaning: The requester cannot approve their own override

stocking_floor_required.meaning: An always-stocked product needs a floor of at least 1

cost_lot_lookup_unavailable.meaning: Inventory could not be reached; the cost-update request fails visibly and is retried

import_invalid_date.meaning: Date is not a valid calendar date

override_release_by_setter.meaning: The admin who set an override cannot release it

roles_last_admin.meaning: The last administrator cannot be removed

role_mirror_failed.meaning: A role change could not be mirrored to the purchasing side; it is retried

auth_csrf_invalid.meaning: The CSRF token is missing or invalid
